wrist_camera.status: Live D435i intrinsics retained; wrist-only refinement against measured-opening finger contours, with fixed 6 mm effective mount. Residual real finger/contact and scene registration mismatch remains.

up_camera.status: Global-only registration constrained by official base flange, tabletop depth and training robot finger observations; existing held-out working-area landmarks checked. Live D435i K retained.

reconstruction.global_intrinsics: Live D435i serial 261622078356 at 640x480 retained; global optical extrinsics refined using robot-base landmarks, table depth and known robot poses.
reconstruction.wrist_configuration: Live D435i K retained. Link6-relative optical pose refined from recorded measured-width finger contours and pre-contact cube images. No physical finger/drive or action change.
reconstruction.dimensions_status: Table height/depth/width and mounting visuals are approximate visual priors, not newly measured dimensions.
reconstruction.clean_workspace: Blue and green cubes are registration references only; omitted by default. No PAP box, tape, or table buttons.
reconstruction.scope: Workspace twin; no task reward, success detector, policy evaluation or learned controller.
reconstruction.appearance: Recorded-image appearance fit: matte green-blue tabletop, broad neutral area light, black polymer materials and fixed per-camera color responses. No texture/background photograph or automatic exposure simulation.

multiview_revision.status: Historical prior revision, superseded by video_registration_revision below
multiview_revision.physical_accuracy: Not measured absolute tool clearance; actual finger geometry, joint zero and base/table relationship unresolved
multiview_revision.reference_objects: Historical pre-contact positions only; real green cube has since moved. Default workspace stays empty.

mount_height_revision.status: Historical 14 mm user estimate; superseded in the simulation by mount_depth_revision. The estimate remains unmodified evidence.
mount_height_revision.height_source: User estimate: tabletop to robot mounting underside about 1.4 cm, excluding robot base housing.
mount_height_revision.frames: Robot base 14 mm above tabletop. Fixed background props/light world coordinates retained; live camera intrinsics unchanged; extrinsics updated by video registration.
mount_height_revision.scope: Default remains empty. Historical calibration_objects are not current cube locations. All prior real trial records remain under their original configs.
mount_height_revision.limitations: Mount-height uncertainty and physical tool/contact calibration remain unresolved.

reconstruction.reference_objects: Pre-contact locations from retry08 only, not current live positions; omitted from the default empty scene.

video_registration_revision.status: Historical adopted fit04 camera/object fit; transforms retained except fixed-camera base-coordinate re-expression in mount_depth_revision
video_registration_revision.physical_accuracy: Within-capture image validation, not absolute metrology. Real/sim closed-gripper width and near-field projections still differ.

mount_coordinate_reexpression.status: Coordinate conversion only; not a measured or accepted mounting height.
mount_coordinate_reexpression.invariants: Table, dynamic object XY/Z, fixed camera world poses, room props and lights unchanged; wrist link-local transform and intrinsics unchanged.
mount_coordinate_reexpression.replay: Use the same recorded joint plan. New tabletop-height IK plans compensate for the mount change.

mount_depth_revision.status: Adopted empirical contact-depth alignment, provisional effective simulation height; not a measured physical mounting thickness
mount_depth_revision.basis: User-reported shallow simulated grasp; 14/10/6 mm same-command PhysX comparison and multi-frame image checks.
mount_depth_revision.selection: 6 mm gives about 18 mm finger/cube vertical overlap versus about 10 mm at 14 mm. 10 mm is a more conservative multi-frame projection compromise and is retained as an alternative.
mount_depth_revision.fixed: Original 2146 joint/gripper commands, table/object world positions, fixed camera world poses, live K, wrist link-local transform, meshes, friction and drives.
mount_depth_revision.limits: Effective contact-depth correction, not identified true mount thickness. Wrist lateral/object registration and finger-width mismatch remain; some visual/depth metrics become worse.

wrist_refinement_revision.status: Adopted conservative wrist-only image alignment, not absolute tool metrology
wrist_refinement_revision.limitations: Uses measured real finger width for fitting. Natural real35.6mm vs sim30mm grasp opening still differs; some static cube views become slightly worse. Development holdouts inspected during candidate selection.

final_revision.status: Selected balanced reference for the available recording; not independently identified physical metrology
final_revision.geometry_and_optics: Retain the 6 mm effective mount, registered fixed camera and measured-opening wrist refinement after joint 6/8/10/14 mm comparison.
final_revision.appearance: Retain current materials and lighting; the single brighter-table candidate improved average colour but exceeded the frozen local-view degradation limit.
final_revision.scope: Empty playground by default; reference cubes are optional calibration fixtures. Other tasks are independent.
limitations: 6 mm is an effective simulated installation height, not a replacement measurement for the approximate 14 mm physical riser.
Natural real/sim closed-gripper opening differs by about 5.6 mm; lateral contact and surface appearance remain approximate.
Validation views belong to the same recorded sequence and were inspected during development; no new real-robot trial was executed.

global_refinement_revision.status: Adopted global-only correction after base/workspace checks; approximate image registration, not independent absolute metrology
global_refinement_revision.scope: Only the fixed global camera pose; wrist, both live K, mounting height, joint states, robot assets, table, object positions, materials, lights, drives and friction preserved.
global_refinement_revision.prior_final_revision: The 2026-11-08 final_revision below remains historical provenance. Current camera preset is global_refinement_revision.frozen_preset.
limitations: Official rounded flange endpoints have approximately 2–3 px annotation uncertainty.
Outer mounting plate is approximate visual geometry and was not used as a known-size target.
Historical holdout frames were previously inspected; these are within-recording checks, not a blind external calibration test.

appearance_revision.scope: Visual appearance only; exact existing optics, geometry, physics and home pose retained. Child task workspace-centered homes remain task-owned.
appearance_revision.response_note: Fixed empirical display-RGB approximation. Real cameras used automatic exposure/white balance, which varies with view; fitted gains are not measured hardware settings.
